text: Bandhan Bank's deposits grew seven thousand eight hundred crore in three months. Sounds good. Look closer.
Retail term deposits, up five thousand eight hundred crore. Bulk deposits, up four thousand three hundred crore.
But CASA, the cheapest money, fell two thousand three hundred crore.
Cheap money out, costly money in. The CASA ratio fell from twenty nine point four to twenty six point seven percent.
So will every new loan cost Bandhan more to fund? Back to the napkin.
